# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Overview

Build a bold, modern landing page for **CreativeHub**, an online learning platform for creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists. The page should feel energetic and inspiring — like stepping into a vibrant creative studio. The goal is simple: get visitors excited about the platform and drive them to start a free trial.

## Vibe & Visual Direction

Think **Skillshare meets Dribbble** — playful yet polished. Use a vibrant color palette anchored by a deep navy or charcoal background in the hero with pops of coral/orange, electric green, or warm yellow as accent colors. Typography should be bold and contemporary — a chunky geometric sans-serif for headlines (like Plus Jakarta Sans or similar) paired with a clean body font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, and subtle hover animations will reinforce the modern, approachable feel.

## Key Priorities

- **Hero conversion flow**: The hero is the most critical section. It needs to immediately communicate the value prop and present two clear sign-up paths (Google and email). Make these CTAs impossible to miss. The category pills beneath should feel browsable and inviting.

- **Course category tabs**: The tabbed course grid is the core interactive experience. Switching between categories (Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, etc.) should feel instant and smooth. Each course card needs a thumbnail, title, instructor name, student count, and duration — make them visually rich.

- **Teacher carousel**: The horizontal scrolling teacher section should feel tactile and explorable, with clear navigation affordances (arrows or scroll indicators).

- **FAQ accordion**: Clean expand/collapse behavior — only one item open at a time feels best here.

- **Stats section**: The platform numbers (425k+ members, 30k+ classes, etc.) should land with visual impact — large type, maybe a contrasting background band.

## Note

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, data content, and interaction specs. The page is responsive, light mode only.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons ## When to Use This Skill Group - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization ## Stack Selection Guide ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon Use when building a standalone application: - E-commerce sites - Marketing websites - SaaS applications - Documentation sites - Blogs and content platforms **Setup:** ```bash npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app npm install remixicon ``` ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon Use when building multiple applications with shared code: - Microfrontends - Multi-tenant platforms - Internal tools with shared component library - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic - Design system with documentation site **Setup:** ```bash npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory # Install remixicon in shared UI packages ``` ### Framework Features Comparison | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | ## Quick Start ### Next.js Application ```bash # Create new project npx create-next-app@latest my-app cd my-app # Install RemixIcon npm install remixicon # Import in layout # app/layout.tsx import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' # Start development npm run dev ``` ### Turborepo Monorepo ```bash # Create monorepo npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo cd my-monorepo # Structure: # apps/web/ - Next.js application # apps/docs/ - Documentation site # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon # packages/config/ - Shared configs # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration # Run all apps npm run dev # Build all packages npm run build ``` ### RemixIcon Integration ```tsx // Webfont (HTML/CSS) // React component import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" ``` ## Reference Navigation **Next.js References:** - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR **Turborepo References:** - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation **RemixIcon References:** - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility ## Common Patterns & Workflows ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo ``` my-monorepo/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app │ └── docs/ # Documentation site ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon │ ├── api-client/ # API client library │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types └── turbo.json # Build pipeline ``` **turbo.json:** ```json { "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", "pipeline": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] }, "dev": { "cache": false, "persistent": true }, "lint": {}, "test": { "dependsOn": ["build"] } } } ``` ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library ```tsx // packages/ui/src/button.tsx import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { return ( ) } // apps/web/app/page.tsx import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" export default function Page() { return } ``` ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching ```tsx // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' // Static generation at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const posts = await getPosts() return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) } // Revalidate every hour async function getPost(slug: string) { const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }) if (!res.ok) return null return res.json() } export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { const post = await getPost(params.slug) if (!post) notFound() return
{post.content}
} ``` ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 18 - run: npm install - run: npx turbo run build test lint env: TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} ``` ## Utility Scripts Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo Usage examples: ```bash # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run # Run tests cd scripts/tests pytest ``` ## Best Practices **Next.js:** - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed - Implement proper loading and error states - Use Image component for automatic optimization - Set proper metadata for SEO - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) **Turborepo:** - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) - Configure outputs for proper caching - Enable remote caching for team collaboration - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only **RemixIcon:** - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering - Provide aria-labels for accessibility - Use currentColor for flexible theming - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons ## Resources - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com ## Implementation Checklist Building with this stack: - [ ] Implement routing and layouts - [ ] Add loading and error states - [ ] Configure image and font optimization - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns - [ ] Configure caching strategies - [ ] Add API routes as needed - 1	# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives
2	
3	## Brand
4	CreativeHub is an online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals, from illustration and design to photography and filmmaking. The platform empowers creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists with hands-on video lessons, structured learning paths, and a vibrant peer community. The tone is modern, playful, and bold.
5	
6	Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #55DA9B (accent green), #5620C1 (accent purple)
7	
8	## Hero Content
9	Title: Creative Classes Taught by the Best Creative Pros
10	Subtitle: Get 7 free days of CreativeHub
11	CTA: "Continue with Google" | "Continue with email"
12	Legal note: By signing up you agree to CreativeHub's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and agree to receive marketing communications from CreativeHub at the email address provided.
13	
14	## Course Categories
15	Horizontal scrolling category pills displayed in the hero area:
16	- Graphic Design
17	- Illustration
18	- Animation
19	- Film & Video
20	- Freelance
21	- UI/UX Design
22	- Productivity
23	- Photography
24	- Fine Art
25	- Marketing
26	
27	## Value Propositions
28	**Creative Learning Made Easy**
29	- **Thousands of creative classes.** Beginner to pro.
30	- **Taught by creative pros and industry icons.**
31	- **Learning Paths** to help you achieve your goals.
32	- **Certificates** to celebrate your accomplishments.
33	
34	## Platform Statistics
35	| Metric | Value |
36	|--------|-------|
37	| Members | 425k+ |
38	| Classes | 30k+ |
39	| Teachers | 9k+ |
40	| App Store Rating | 4.8 ★ |
41

43	Section title: Explore Inspiring Online Courses
44	
45	Category tabs: Featured · Music · Drawing & Painting · Marketing · Animation · Social Media · UI/UX Design · Creative Writing · Digital Illustration · Film & Video · Crafts · Freelance & Entrepreneurship · Graphic Design · Photography · Productivity

# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Brand
CreativeHub is an online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals, from illustration and design to photography and filmmaking. The platform empowers creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists with hands-on video lessons, structured learning paths, and a vibrant peer community. The tone is modern, playful, and bold.

Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #55DA9B (accent green), #5620C1 (accent purple)

## Hero Content
Title: Creative Classes Taught by the Best Creative Pros
Subtitle: Get 7 free days of CreativeHub
CTA: "Continue with Google" | "Continue with email"
Legal note: By signing up you agree to CreativeHub's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and agree to receive marketing communications from CreativeHub at the email address provided.

## Course Categories
Horizontal scrolling category pills displayed in the hero area:
- Graphic Design
- Illustration
- Animation
- Film & Video
- Freelance
- UI/UX Design
- Productivity
- Photography
- Fine Art
- Marketing

## Value Propositions
**Creative Learning Made Easy**
- **Thousands of creative classes.** Beginner to pro.
- **Taught by creative pros and industry icons.**
- **Learning Paths** to help you achieve your goals.
- **Certificates** to celebrate your accomplishments.

## Platform Statistics
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Members | 425k+ |
| Classes | 30k+ |
| Teachers | 9k+ |
| App Store Rating | 4.8 ★ |

## Featured Courses
Section title: Explore Inspiring Online Courses

Category tabs: Featured · Music · Drawing & Painting · Marketing · Animation · Social Media · UI/UX Design · Creative Writing · Digital Illustration · Film & Video · Crafts · Freelance & Entrepreneurship · Graphic Design · Photography · Productivity

| Course Title | Instructor | Students | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kickstart your Creativity with Procreate: 20 Fun Drawings for Beginners and Beyond | Lisa Bardot | 24,872 | 6h 24m |
| Social Media Content Creation in Canva: From Beginner to Advanced | Maggie Stara | 44,495 | 13h 19m |
| Landscapes: A Free-Flow Watercolour Masterclass | Jane Davies | 2,579 | 1h 42m |
| Figma UI UX Design Advanced: Become a Pro | Daniel Scott | 6,692 | 8h 48m |
| ChatGPT for Creatives: AI-Powered SEO, Marketing, & Productivity | Peggy Dean | 18,842 | 1h 18m |
| How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide | Brent Eviston | 26,243 | 5h 57m |
| Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners | Jordy Vandeput | 17,887 | 3h 44m |
| iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone | Sean Dalton | 13,423 | 1h 34m |

## Creative Feed
Section title: Explore Your Creative Feed

- **Stay Inspired** — Discover trending topics, get quick answers, and find your people.
- **Stay Connected** — Follow your peers and teachers, exchange perspectives, and share some love.
- **Keep Creating** — Explore new ideas for your next project, post your work, and get feedback.

## Expert Teachers
Section title: Learn from Creative Experts
Subtitle: CreativeHub teachers are industry leaders excited to share their tools, techniques, and professional journeys with you.

| Name | Specialty |
|---|---|
| Lisa Bardot | Illustrator |
| Daniel Scott | Digital Designer |
| Derek Elliot | Animator, Product Designer |
| Aaron Draplin | Graphic Designer |
| Zaneena Nabeel | Watercolor Artist |
| Emonee LaRussa | Motion Graphics Artist |
| Brent Eviston | Master Artist |
| Jordy Vandeput | Filmmaker and Youtuber |

## Student Testimonials
Section title: Why Students Love CreativeHub

- **Rachel R** — "CreativeHub was the best learning decision I've ever made… Real-world skills without the financial burden of traditional school."
- **Elli V** — "I love that CreativeHub is a platform where I can find other creatives and we can support each other on our learning journey."
- **Katrina** — "It's rare that I subscribe for anything, but this is one subscription I can't imagine not having."
- **Savonne M** — "CreativeHub helps me level up my skills, while also letting me explore… teachers bring vibrant personalities and valuable insights."

## Teams
Section title: CreativeHub for Teams
Body: Set your team up for success with reimagined learning to empower their personal and professional growth. With inspiring classes on soft skills, business essentials, well-being and more, your whole team will have deep knowledge and expertise at their fingertips.
CTA: "Learn More"

## FAQ
Section title: Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is CreativeHub?** — CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey.
- **What is included in my membership?** — As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more.
- **What can I learn?** — CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub.
- **What happens after my trial is over?** — After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round.
- **Can I teach on the platform?** — Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more.

## Footer Navigation
**Art & Illustration:** Illustration · Digital Art · Drawing · Painting · Watercolor
**Graphic Design:** Graphic Design · UI/UX Design · Type Design · Surface Pattern Design · Motion Design
**Creative Career:** Marketing · Freelance · AI · Productivity · Social Media

    icon: "ri-camera-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #0EA5E9 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Photography"]
  }
];

const TABS = [
  "Featured", "Music", "Drawing & Painting", "Marketing", "Animation",
  "Social Media", "UI/UX Design", "Creative Writing", "Digital Illustration",
  "Film & Video", "Crafts", "Freelance & Entrepreneurship",
  "Graphic Design", "Photography", "Productivity"
];

const TEACHERS = [
  { name: "Lisa Bardot",      specialty: "Illustrator",                color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EC4899,#8B5CF6)" },
  { name: "Daniel Scott",     specialty: "Digital Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#5620C1,#8B4CF8)" },
  { name: "Derek Elliot",     specialty: "Animator & Product Designer",color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#6366F1)" },
  { name: "Aaron Draplin",    specialty: "Graphic Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F97316,#FBBF24)" },
  { name: "Zaneena Nabeel",   specialty: "Watercolor Artist",          color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#14B8A6,#22C55E)" },
  { name: "Emonee LaRussa",   specialty: "Motion Graphics Artist",     color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EF4444,#EC4899)" },
  { name: "Brent Eviston",    specialty: "Master Artist",              color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F59E0B,#EF4444)" },
  { name: "Jordy Vandeput",   specialty: "Filmmaker & YouTuber",       color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#1E3A8A,#4F46E5)" }
];

const FAQS = [
  {
    q: "What is CreativeHub?",
    a: "CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey."
  },
  {
    q: "What is included in my membership?",
    a: "As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more."
  },
  {
    q: "What can I learn?",
    a: "CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub."
  },
  {
    q: "What happens after my trial is over?",
    a: "After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round."
  },
  {
    q: "Can I teach on the platform?",
    a: "Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more."
  }
];

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HELPERS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function initials(name) {
  return name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function formatStudents(s) {
  return s.replace(/,/g, ',');
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   COURSE TABS & GRID
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
let activeTab = "Featured";

function renderTabs() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
  wrap.innerHTML = TABS.map(t =>
    `<button class="tab-btn${t === activeTab ? ' active' : ''}" data-tab="${t}">${t}</button>`
  ).join('');

  wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeTab = btn.dataset.tab;
      renderTabs();
      renderCourses();
      // scroll active tab into view
      btn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
    });
  });
}

function renderCourses() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('courseGrid');
  const filtered = COURSES.filter(c => c.categories.includes(activeTab));

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="courses-empty">
        <i class="ri-search-line"></i>
        <p>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon — <a href="#" onclick="setTab('Featured');return false;" style="color:var(--purple);">browse Featured</a> in the meantime.</p>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
    <div class="course-card" onclick="openModal('email')">
      <div class="course-thumb">
        <div class="course-thumb-bg" style="background:${c.gradient}"></div>
        <i class="${c.icon} course-thumb-icon"></i>
        <div class="play-overlay">
          <div class="play-circle"><i class="ri-play-fill"></i></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="course-info">
        <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
        <div class="course-instructor">${c.instructor}</div>
        <div class="course-meta">
          <span><i class="ri-group-line"></i> ${c.students}</span>
          <span><i class="ri-time-line"></i> ${c.duration}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

function setTab(tab) {
  activeTab = tab;
  renderTabs();
  renderCourses();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TEACHER CAROUSEL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderTeachers() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const dotsEl = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  track.innerHTML = TEACHERS.map(t => `
    <div class="teacher-card">
      <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background:${t.color}">${initials(t.name)}</div>
      <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
      <div class="teacher-spec">${t.specialty}</div>
      <button class="follow-btn"><i class="ri-user-add-line"></i> Follow</button>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  // dots
  const count = TEACHERS.length;
  dotsEl.innerHTML = Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) =>
    `<span class="carousel-dot${i === 0 ? ' active' : ''}" data-i="${i}"></span>`
  ).join('');

  dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToTeacher(parseInt(dot.dataset.i)));
  });

  document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: -cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateDots);
}

function scrollToTeacher(i) {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const card = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card')[i];
  if (card) card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'start' });
}

function updateDots() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
  if (!cards.length) return;
  const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
  const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / cardW);
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach((d, i) =>
    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx)
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   FAQ ACCORDION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderFAQ() {
  const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
  list.innerHTML = FAQS.map((f, i) => `
    <div class="faq-item">
      <button class="faq-q" data-i="${i}" aria-expanded="false">
        ${f.q}
        <span class="faq-icon"><i class="ri-add-line"></i></span>
      </button>
      <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-${i}">
        <div class="faq-answer-inner">${f.a}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.i);
      const isOpen = btn.classList.contains('open');

      // close all
      list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('open');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${b.dataset.i}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = '0';
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        btn.classList.add('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${idx}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = ans.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   MODAL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function openModal(mode) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  if (mode === 'email') {
    setTimeout(() => emailInput.focus(), 320);
  }
}

function closeModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  overlay.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

document.getElementById('signupModal').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('signupModal')) closeModal();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalGoogleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  alert('Google OAuth flow would initiate here. (Demo)');
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalEmailSubmit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
    document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '#EF4444';
    document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
    return;
  }
  alert(`Welcome to CreativeHub! A confirmation email has been sent to ${email}. (Demo)`);
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('input', () => {
  document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '';
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO CATEGORY PILLS — deep-link to tab
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.hero-pill').forEach(pill => {
  pill.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cat = pill.dataset.cat;
    setTab(cat);
    const section = document.getElementById('courses');
    if (section) {
      setTimeout(() => section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 50);
    }
  });
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   INIT
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
renderTabs();
renderCourses();
renderTeachers();
renderFAQ();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.3.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       DESIGN SYSTEM
       ============================================================ */
    :root {
      --black:        #000000;
      --green:        #55DA9B;
      --purple:       #5620C1;
      --purple-mid:   #6B35D4;
      --purple-light: #8B52E8;
      --dark:         #080812;
      --dark-card:    #0F0F1E;
      --white:        #FFFFFF;
      --off-white:    #F7F6FD;
      --gray-100:     #F2F0FA;
      --gray-200:     #E4E1F5;
      --gray-400:     #9E9BB8;
      --gray-600:     #6B6880;
      --gray-800:     #2D2A45;
      --font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --radius-sm:   8px;
      --radius-md:   12px;
      --radius-lg:   16px;
      --radius-xl:   24px;
      --radius-pill: 100px;
      --shadow-sm:   0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md:   0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.09), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      --shadow-lg:   0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.13), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-purple: 0 4px 20px rgba(86,32,193,0.28);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--black);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    a { text-decoration: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       UTILITIES
       ============================================================ */
    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    .section-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.08);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);

    }

    .section-subtitle {

      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-top: 10px;
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       BUTTONS
       ============================================================ */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-nav-signin {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      padding: 9px 18px;
    }
    .btn-nav-signin:hover { background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--black); }

    .btn-nav-signup {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: white;
      padding: 9px 22px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-purple);
    }
    .btn-nav-signup:hover { background: var(--purple-mid); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(86,32,193,0.38); }

    .btn-google {
      background: white;
      color: var(--black);
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);

    }
    .btn-google:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

    .btn-email {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    }
    .btn-email:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

    /* ============================================================
       NAVIGATION
       ============================================================ */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      height: 68px;
    }

    .nav-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 19px;

      color: var(--black);

      flex-shrink: 0;

    .nav-logo-mark {

    .hero-categories-label {

    /* ============================================================
       FEATURES
       ============================================================ */
    .features {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;

      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;

    }

    .feature-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 13px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 21px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .fi-4 { background: #EF4444; color: white; }

    .feature-content h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);

    .fv-hero-card {

      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 27px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .fv-hero-card h4 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .fv-hero-card p { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.75; }

    .fv-stat-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .fv-num {
      font-size: 34px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--purple);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .fv-lbl { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       STATS
       ============================================================ */
    .stats-band {
      background: var(--dark);
      padding: 72px 0;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 58px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       COURSES
       ============================================================ */
    .courses { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .course-tabs-wrap {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 2px 0 6px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .tab-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.04); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--purple); color: white; border-color: var(--purple); box-shadow: var(--shadow-purple); }

    .course-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .course-thumb-icon {
      font-size: 44px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .course-card:hover .course-thumb-icon { transform: scale(1.15); }

    .play-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .course-card:hover .play-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .play-circle {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--purple);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .course-info { padding: 14px 16px 16px; }

    .course-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-instructor { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 10px; }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .course-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .course-meta i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* No courses message */
    .courses-empty {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 60px 24px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .courses-empty i { font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; }
    .courses-empty p { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       CREATIVE FEED
       ============================================================ */
    .creative-feed { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 34px 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .feed-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }

    .feed-icon-wrap {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 25px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .fi-green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.14); color: #1A9466; }
    .fi-purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .fi-amber { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); color: #C97D0A; }

    .feed-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .feed-card p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEACHERS
       ============================================================ */
    .teachers { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .carousel-outer { position: relative; margin-top: 40px; }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding: 4px 2px 8px;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 210px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 26px 20px 22px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .teacher-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }

    .teacher-name { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .teacher-spec { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 16px; }

    .follow-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.08);
      padding: 7px 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .follow-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); color: white; }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.05); }

    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-dot.active { width: 20px; background: var(--purple); }

    /* ============================================================
       TESTIMONIALS
       ============================================================ */
    .testimonials { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 30px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.26s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .t-quote {
      font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
      font-size: 52px;
      line-height: 0.8;
      color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }

    .t-text {
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.72;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .t-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

    .t-avatar {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .t-name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); }

    .t-stars { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-top: 3px; }
    .t-stars i { font-size: 12px; color: #F59E0B; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEAMS
       ============================================================ */
    .teams {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: var(--purple);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -150px; right: -200px;
      width: 700px; height: 700px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-glow-2 {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -200px; left: -100px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85,218,155,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 70px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .teams-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .teams-text p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .btn-teams-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--purple);
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s;
      font-family: var(--font);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-teams-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); }

    .teams-cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .teams-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-card-val {
      font-size: 38px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .teams-card-lbl { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       FAQ
       ============================================================ */
    .faq { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .faq-list { max-width: 760px; margin: 40px auto 0; }

    .faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-q {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 22px 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: color 0.18s;
      user-select: none;
      list-style: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .faq-q:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .faq-q.open { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .faq-q.open .faq-icon {
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1);
      color: var(--purple);
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.32s ease;
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 22px;
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.78;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================================ */
    .footer { background: var(--dark); padding: 72px 0 36px; }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      padding-bottom: 52px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }

    .footer-brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .footer-brand-logo-mark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.38);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .social-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      font-size: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .social-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: white; }

    .footer-nav-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col a { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transition: color 0.18s; }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-bottom-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-copy { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); }

    .footer-legal { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* ============================================================
       MODAL
       ============================================================ */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(8,8,18,0.76);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.28s;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }

    .modal-box {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 42px 40px 36px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 436px;
      position: relative;
      transform: scale(0.94) translateY(16px);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open .modal-box { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }

    .modal-close-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px; right: 14px;
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }
    .modal-close-btn:hover { background: var(--gray-200); }

    .modal-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .modal-logo-mark {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .modal-h { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--black); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .modal-sub { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 28px; }
    .modal-sub strong { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }

    .modal-google-btn {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: white;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .modal-google-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gray-400); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

    .google-logo {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .modal-divider {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 18px 0;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .modal-divider::before, .modal-divider::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .modal-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--black);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .modal-input:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }
    .modal-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .modal-submit-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px;
      background: var(--purple);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s;
    }
    .modal-submit-btn:hover { background: var(--purple-mid); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(86,32,193,0.38); }

    .modal-legal-text {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .modal-legal-text a { color: var(--gray-600); text-decoration: underline; }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE
       ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .course-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stat-item { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }
      .stat-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
      .footer-nav-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HELPERS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function initials(name) {
  return name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function formatStudents(s) {
  return s.replace(/,/g, ',');
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   COURSE TABS & GRID
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
let activeTab = "Featured";

function renderTabs() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
  wrap.innerHTML = TABS.map(t =>
    `<button class="tab-btn${t === activeTab ? ' active' : ''}" data-tab="${t}">${t}</button>`
  ).join('');

  wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeTab = btn.dataset.tab;
      renderTabs();
      renderCourses();
      // scroll active tab into view
      btn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
    });
  });
}

function renderCourses() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('courseGrid');
  const filtered = COURSES.filter(c => c.categories.includes(activeTab));

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="courses-empty">
        <i class="ri-search-line"></i>
        <p>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon — <a href="#" onclick="setTab('Featured');return false;" style="color:var(--purple);">browse Featured</a> in the meantime.</p>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
    <div class="course-card" onclick="openModal('email')">
      <div class="course-thumb">
        <div class="course-thumb-bg" style="background:${c.gradient}"></div>
        <i class="${c.icon} course-thumb-icon"></i>
        <div class="play-overlay">
          <div class="play-circle"><i class="ri-play-fill"></i></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="course-info">
        <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
        <div class="course-instructor">${c.instructor}</div>
        <div class="course-meta">
          <span><i class="ri-group-line"></i> ${c.students}</span>
          <span><i class="ri-time-line"></i> ${c.duration}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

function setTab(tab) {
  activeTab = tab;
  renderTabs();
  renderCourses();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TEACHER CAROUSEL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderTeachers() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const dotsEl = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  track.innerHTML = TEACHERS.map(t => `
    <div class="teacher-card">
      <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background:${t.color}">${initials(t.name)}</div>
      <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
      <div class="teacher-spec">${t.specialty}</div>
      <button class="follow-btn"><i class="ri-user-add-line"></i> Follow</button>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  // dots
  const count = TEACHERS.length;
  dotsEl.innerHTML = Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) =>
    `<span class="carousel-dot${i === 0 ? ' active' : ''}" data-i="${i}"></span>`
  ).join('');

  dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToTeacher(parseInt(dot.dataset.i)));
  });

  document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: -cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateDots);
}

function scrollToTeacher(i) {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const card = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card')[i];
  if (card) card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'start' });
}

function updateDots() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
  if (!cards.length) return;
  const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
  const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / cardW);
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach((d, i) =>
    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx)
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   FAQ ACCORDION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderFAQ() {
  const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
  list.innerHTML = FAQS.map((f, i) => `
    <div class="faq-item">
      <button class="faq-q" data-i="${i}" aria-expanded="false">
        ${f.q}
        <span class="faq-icon"><i class="ri-add-line"></i></span>
      </button>
      <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-${i}">
        <div class="faq-answer-inner">${f.a}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.i);
      const isOpen = btn.classList.contains('open');

      // close all
      list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('open');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${b.dataset.i}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = '0';
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        btn.classList.add('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${idx}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = ans.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   MODAL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function openModal(mode) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  if (mode === 'email') {
    setTimeout(() => emailInput.focus(), 320);
  }
}

function closeModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  overlay.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

document.getElementById('signupModal').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('signupModal')) closeModal();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalGoogleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  alert('Google OAuth flow would initiate here. (Demo)');
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalEmailSubmit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
    document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '#EF4444';
    document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
    return;
  }
  alert(`Welcome to CreativeHub! A confirmation email has been sent to ${email}. (Demo)`);
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('input', () => {
  document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '';
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO CATEGORY PILLS — deep-link to tab
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.hero-pill').forEach(pill => {
  pill.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cat = pill.dataset.cat;
    setTab(cat);
    const section = document.getElementById('courses');
    if (section) {
      setTimeout(() => section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 50);
    }
  });
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   INIT
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
renderTabs();
renderCourses();
renderTeachers();
renderFAQ();
</script>
