      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 21px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fi-1 { background: var(--purple); color: white; }
    .fi-2 { background: var(--green); color: #0A5C38; }
    .fi-3 { background: #F59E0B; color: white; }
    .fi-4 { background: #EF4444; color: white; }

    .feature-content h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .feature-content p { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.55; }

    .features-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .fv-hero-card {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #8B4CF8 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 26px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      color: white;
    }

    .fv-hero-icon {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 27px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .fv-hero-card h4 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .fv-hero-card p { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.75; }

    .fv-stat-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .fv-num {
      font-size: 34px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--purple);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .fv-lbl { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       STATS
       ============================================================ */
    .stats-band {
      background: var(--dark);
      padding: 72px 0;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 58px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       COURSES
       ============================================================ */
    .courses { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .course-tabs-wrap {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 2px 0 6px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .tab-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.04); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--purple); color: white; border-color: var(--purple); box-shadow: var(--shadow-purple); }

    .course-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .course-thumb-icon {
      font-size: 44px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .course-card:hover .course-thumb-icon { transform: scale(1.15); }

    .play-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .course-card:hover .play-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .play-circle {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--purple);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .course-info { padding: 14px 16px 16px; }

    .course-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-instructor { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 10px; }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .course-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .course-meta i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* No courses message */
    .courses-empty {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 60px 24px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .courses-empty i { font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; }
    .courses-empty p { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       CREATIVE FEED
       ============================================================ */
    .creative-feed { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 34px 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .feed-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }

    .feed-icon-wrap {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 25px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .fi-green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.14); color: #1A9466; }
    .fi-purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .fi-amber { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); color: #C97D0A; }

    .feed-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .feed-card p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEACHERS
       ============================================================ */
    .teachers { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .carousel-outer { position: relative; margin-top: 40px; }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding: 4px 2px 8px;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 210px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 26px 20px 22px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .teacher-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }

    .teacher-name { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .teacher-spec { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 16px; }

    .follow-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.08);
      padding: 7px 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .follow-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); color: white; }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.05); }

    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-dot.active { width: 20px; background: var(--purple); }

    /* ============================================================
       TESTIMONIALS
       ============================================================ */
    .testimonials { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 30px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.26s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .t-quote {
      font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
      font-size: 52px;
      line-height: 0.8;
      color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }

    .t-text {
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.72;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .t-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

    .t-avatar {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .t-name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); }

    .t-stars { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-top: 3px; }
    .t-stars i { font-size: 12px; color: #F59E0B; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEAMS
       ============================================================ */
    .teams {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: var(--purple);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -150px; right: -200px;
      width: 700px; height: 700px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-glow-2 {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -200px; left: -100px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85,218,155,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 70px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .teams-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .teams-text p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .btn-teams-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--purple);
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s;
      font-family: var(--font);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-teams-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); }

    .teams-cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .teams-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-card-val {
      font-size: 38px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .teams-card-lbl { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       FAQ
       ============================================================ */
    .faq { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .faq-list { max-width: 760px; margin: 40px auto 0; }

    .faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-q {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 22px 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: color 0.18s;
      user-select: none;
      list-style: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .faq-q:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .faq-q.open { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .faq-q.open .faq-icon {
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1);
      color: var(--purple);
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.32s ease;
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 22px;
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.78;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================================ */
    .footer { background: var(--dark); padding: 72px 0 36px; }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      padding-bottom: 52px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }

    .footer-brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .footer-brand-logo-mark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.38);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .social-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      font-size: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .social-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: white; }

    .footer-nav-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col a { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transition: color 0.18s; }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-bottom-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-copy { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); }

    .footer-legal { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* ============================================================
       MODAL
       ============================================================ */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(8,8,18,0.76);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.28s;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }

    .modal-box {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 42px 40px 36px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 436px;
      position: relative;
      transform: scale(0.94) translateY(16px);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open .modal-box { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }

    .modal-close-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px; right: 14px;
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }
    .modal-close-btn:hover { background: var(--gray-200); }

    .modal-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .modal-logo-mark {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .modal-h { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--black); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .modal-sub { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 28px; }
    .modal-sub strong { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }

    .modal-google-btn {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: white;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--black);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .modal-google-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gray-400); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

    .google-logo {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .modal-divider {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 18px 0;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .modal-divider::before, .modal-divider::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .modal-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--black);
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .modal-input:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }
    .modal-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .modal-submit-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px;
      background: var(--purple);
      color: white;
      border: none;

        <path d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.07l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.53 6.16-4.53z" fill="#EA4335"/>
      </svg>
      Continue with Google
    </button>

    <div class="modal-divider">or</div>

    <input type="email" class="modal-input" id="emailInput" placeholder="Enter your email address" autocomplete="email">
    <button class="modal-submit-btn" id="modalEmailSubmit">Continue with email</button>

    <p class="modal-legal-text">
      By signing up you agree to our <a href="#">Terms of Service</a> and <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a>. You may receive marketing emails which you can unsubscribe from at any time.
    </p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ================================================================
     JAVASCRIPT
     ================================================================ -->
<script>
/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   DATA
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
const COURSES = [
  {
    id: 1,
    title: "Kickstart your Creativity with Procreate: 20 Fun Drawings for Beginners and Beyond",
    instructor: "Lisa Bardot",
    students: "24,872",
    duration: "6h 24m",
    icon: "ri-pencil-ruler-2-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #EC4899 0%, #8B5CF6 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting", "Digital Illustration", "Crafts"]
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: "Social Media Content Creation in Canva: From Beginner to Advanced",
    instructor: "Maggie Stara",
    students: "44,495",
    duration: "13h 19m",
    icon: "ri-layout-masonry-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #FBBF24 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Social Media", "Marketing", "Graphic Design"]
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    title: "Landscapes: A Free-Flow Watercolour Masterclass",
    instructor: "Jane Davies",
    students: "2,579",
    duration: "1h 42m",
    icon: "ri-landscape-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #14B8A6 0%, #22C55E 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting", "Crafts"]
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    title: "Figma UI UX Design Advanced: Become a Pro",
    instructor: "Daniel Scott",
    students: "6,692",
    duration: "8h 48m",
    icon: "ri-layout-4-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #6366F1 0%, #8B5CF6 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "UI/UX Design", "Graphic Design"]
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    title: "ChatGPT for Creatives: AI-Powered SEO, Marketing, & Productivity",
    instructor: "Peggy Dean",
    students: "18,842",
    duration: "1h 18m",
    icon: "ri-robot-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6 0%, #06B6D4 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Marketing", "Productivity", "Freelance & Entrepreneurship", "Creative Writing"]
  },
  {
    id: 6,
    title: "How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide",
    instructor: "Brent Eviston",
    students: "26,243",
    duration: "5h 57m",
    icon: "ri-edit-2-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444 0%, #F97316 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting", "Digital Illustration"]
  },
  {
    id: 7,
    title: "Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners",
    instructor: "Jordy Vandeput",
    students: "17,887",
    duration: "3h 44m",
    icon: "ri-film-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1E3A8A 0%, #4F46E5 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Film & Video", "Animation"]
  },
  {
    id: 8,
    title: "iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone",
    instructor: "Sean Dalton",
    students: "13,423",
    duration: "1h 34m",
    icon: "ri-camera-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #0EA5E9 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Photography"]
  }
];

const TABS = [
  "Featured", "Music", "Drawing & Painting", "Marketing", "Animation",
  "Social Media", "UI/UX Design", "Creative Writing", "Digital Illustration",
  "Film & Video", "Crafts", "Freelance & Entrepreneurship",
  "Graphic Design", "Photography", "Productivity"
];

const TEACHERS = [
  { name: "Lisa Bardot",      specialty: "Illustrator",                color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EC4899,#8B5CF6)" },
  { name: "Daniel Scott",     specialty: "Digital Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#5620C1,#8B4CF8)" },
  { name: "Derek Elliot",     specialty: "Animator & Product Designer",color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#6366F1)" },
  { name: "Aaron Draplin",    specialty: "Graphic Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F97316,#FBBF24)" },
  { name: "Zaneena Nabeel",   specialty: "Watercolor Artist",          color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#14B8A6,#22C55E)" },
  { name: "Emonee LaRussa",   specialty: "Motion Graphics Artist",     color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EF4444,#EC4899)" },
  { name: "Brent Eviston",    specialty: "Master Artist",              color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F59E0B,#EF4444)" },
  { name: "Jordy Vandeput",   specialty: "Filmmaker & YouTuber",       color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#1E3A8A,#4F46E5)" }
];

const FAQS = [
  {
    q: "What is CreativeHub?",
    a: "CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey."
  },
  {
    q: "What is included in my membership?",
    a: "As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more."
  },
  {
    q: "What can I learn?",
    a: "CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub."
  },
  {
    q: "What happens after my trial is over?",
    a: "After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round."
  },
  {
    q: "Can I teach on the platform?",
    a: "Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more."
  }
];

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HELPERS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function initials(name) {
  return name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function formatStudents(s) {
  return s.replace(/,/g, ',');
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   COURSE TABS & GRID
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
let activeTab = "Featured";

function renderTabs() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
  wrap.innerHTML = TABS.map(t =>
    `<button class="tab-btn${t === activeTab ? ' active' : ''}" data-tab="${t}">${t}</button>`
  ).join('');

  wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeTab = btn.dataset.tab;
      renderTabs();
      renderCourses();
      // scroll active tab into view
      btn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
    });
  });
}

function renderCourses() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('courseGrid');
  const filtered = COURSES.filter(c => c.categories.includes(activeTab));

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="courses-empty">
        <i class="ri-search-line"></i>
        <p>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon — <a href="#" onclick="setTab('Featured');return false;" style="color:var(--purple);">browse Featured</a> in the meantime.</p>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
    <div class="course-card" onclick="openModal('email')">
      <div class="course-thumb">
        <div class="course-thumb-bg" style="background:${c.gradient}"></div>
        <i class="${c.icon} course-thumb-icon"></i>
        <div class="play-overlay">
          <div class="play-circle"><i class="ri-play-fill"></i></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="course-info">
        <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
        <div class="course-instructor">${c.instructor}</div>
        <div class="course-meta">
          <span><i class="ri-group-line"></i> ${c.students}</span>
          <span><i class="ri-time-line"></i> ${c.duration}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

function setTab(tab) {
  activeTab = tab;
  renderTabs();
  renderCourses();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TEACHER CAROUSEL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderTeachers() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const dotsEl = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  track.innerHTML = TEACHERS.map(t => `
    <div class="teacher-card">
      <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background:${t.color}">${initials(t.name)}</div>
      <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
      <div class="teacher-spec">${t.specialty}</div>
      <button class="follow-btn"><i class="ri-user-add-line"></i> Follow</button>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  // dots
  const count = TEACHERS.length;
  dotsEl.innerHTML = Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) =>
    `<span class="carousel-dot${i === 0 ? ' active' : ''}" data-i="${i}"></span>`
  ).join('');

  dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToTeacher(parseInt(dot.dataset.i)));
  });

  document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: -cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateDots);
}

function scrollToTeacher(i) {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const card = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card')[i];
  if (card) card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'start' });
}

function updateDots() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
  if (!cards.length) return;
  const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
  const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / cardW);
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach((d, i) =>
    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx)
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   FAQ ACCORDION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderFAQ() {
  const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
  list.innerHTML = FAQS.map((f, i) => `
    <div class="faq-item">
      <button class="faq-q" data-i="${i}" aria-expanded="false">
        ${f.q}
        <span class="faq-icon"><i class="ri-add-line"></i></span>
      </button>
      <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-${i}">
        <div class="faq-answer-inner">${f.a}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.i);
      const isOpen = btn.classList.contains('open');

      // close all
      list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('open');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${b.dataset.i}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = '0';
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        btn.classList.add('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${idx}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = ans.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   MODAL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function openModal(mode) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  if (mode === 'email') {
    setTimeout(() => emailInput.focus(), 320);
  }
}

function closeModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  overlay.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

document.getElementById('signupModal').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('signupModal')) closeModal();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalGoogleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  alert('Google OAuth flow would initiate here. (Demo)');
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalEmailSubmit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
    document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '#EF4444';
    document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
    return;
  }
  alert(`Welcome to CreativeHub! A confirmation email has been sent to ${email}. (Demo)`);
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('input', () => {
  document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '';
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO CATEGORY PILLS — deep-link to tab
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.hero-pill').forEach(pill => {
  pill.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cat = pill.dataset.cat;
    setTab(cat);
    const section = document.getElementById('courses');
    if (section) {
      setTimeout(() => section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 50);
    }
  });
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   INIT
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
renderTabs();
renderCourses();
renderTeachers();
renderFAQ();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Join 425k+ creative professionals on CreativeHub. Thousands of online classes in illustration, design, photography, filmmaking, and more. Start your free 7-day trial.">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.3.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       DESIGN SYSTEM
       ============================================================ */
    :root {
      --black:        #000000;
      --green:        #55DA9B;
      --purple:       #5620C1;
      --purple-mid:   #6B35D4;
      --purple-light: #8B52E8;
      --dark:         #080812;
      --dark-card:    #0F0F1E;
      --white:        #FFFFFF;
      --off-white:    #F7F6FD;
      --gray-100:     #F2F0FA;
      --gray-200:     #E4E1F5;
      --gray-400:     #9E9BB8;
      --gray-600:     #6B6880;
      --gray-800:     #2D2A45;
      --font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --radius-sm:   8px;
      --radius-md:   12px;
      --radius-lg:   16px;
      --radius-xl:   24px;
      --radius-pill: 100px;
      --shadow-sm:   0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      --shadow-md:   0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.09), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      --shadow-lg:   0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.13), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-purple: 0 4px 20px rgba(86,32,193,0.28);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      color: var(--black);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
    a { text-decoration: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       UTILITIES
       ============================================================ */
    .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    .section-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.08);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.15;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-top: 10px;
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       BUTTONS
       ============================================================ */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-nav-signin {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      padding: 9px 18px;
    }
    .btn-nav-signin:hover { background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--black); }

    .btn-nav-signup {
      background: var(--purple);
      color: white;
      padding: 9px 22px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-purple);
    }
    .btn-nav-signup:hover { background: var(--purple-mid); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(86,32,193,0.38); }

    .btn-google {
      background: white;
      color: var(--black);
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .btn-google:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

    .btn-email {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: white;
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
    }
    .btn-email:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

    /* ============================================================
       NAVIGATION
       ============================================================ */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 200;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .nav-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      height: 68px;
    }

    .nav-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--black);
      text-decoration: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-right: 16px;
    }

    .nav-logo-mark {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 9px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: color 0.18s, background 0.18s;
    }
    .nav-link:hover { color: var(--black); background: var(--gray-100); }

    .nav-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; }

    /* ============================================================
       HERO
       ============================================================ */
    .hero {
      background: var(--dark);
      padding: 88px 0 64px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -280px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 1100px;
      height: 700px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(86,32,193,0.45) 0%, rgba(85,218,155,0.08) 50%, transparent 72%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-dots {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(85,218,155,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(85,218,155,0.22);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 7px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 6.5vw, 76px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.07;
      color: white;
      max-width: 820px;
      margin: 0 auto 18px;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .hero-title .accent-green {
      background: linear-gradient(130deg, var(--green) 0%, #9BEDD0 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);
      margin-bottom: 38px;
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      max-width: 500px;
      margin: 0 auto 52px;
      line-height: 1.65;
    }
    .hero-legal a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48); text-decoration: underline; }

    .hero-categories-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .hero-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .hero-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(85,218,155,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(85,218,155,0.35);
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FEATURES
       ============================================================ */
    .features {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .features-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    .feature-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }
    .feature-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 13px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 21px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fi-1 { background: var(--purple); color: white; }
    .fi-2 { background: var(--green); color: #0A5C38; }
    .fi-3 { background: #F59E0B; color: white; }
    .fi-4 { background: #EF4444; color: white; }

    .feature-content h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }
    .feature-content p { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.55; }

    .features-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .fv-hero-card {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, #8B4CF8 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 26px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      color: white;
    }

    .fv-hero-icon {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 27px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .fv-hero-card h4 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .fv-hero-card p { font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.75; }

    .fv-stat-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 22px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .fv-num {
      font-size: 34px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--purple);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .fv-lbl { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       STATS
       ============================================================ */
    .stats-band {
      background: var(--dark);
      padding: 72px 0;
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }
    .stat-item:last-child { border-right: none; }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(38px, 5vw, 58px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       COURSES
       ============================================================ */
    .courses { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .course-tabs-wrap {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 2px 0 6px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .tab-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.04); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--purple); color: white; border-color: var(--purple); box-shadow: var(--shadow-purple); }

    .course-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .course-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-thumb-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .course-thumb-icon {
      font-size: 44px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .course-card:hover .course-thumb-icon { transform: scale(1.15); }

    .play-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .course-card:hover .play-overlay { opacity: 1; }

    .play-circle {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--purple);
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .course-info { padding: 14px 16px 16px; }

    .course-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .course-instructor { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--gray-600); margin-bottom: 10px; }

    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .course-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .course-meta i { font-size: 13px; }

    /* No courses message */
    .courses-empty {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 60px 24px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .courses-empty i { font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; }
    .courses-empty p { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       CREATIVE FEED
       ============================================================ */
    .creative-feed { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .feed-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .feed-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 34px 28px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .feed-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }

    .feed-icon-wrap {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 25px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }
    .fi-green { background: rgba(85,218,155,0.14); color: #1A9466; }
    .fi-purple { background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1); color: var(--purple); }
    .fi-amber { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.12); color: #C97D0A; }

    .feed-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .feed-card p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.72; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEACHERS
       ============================================================ */
    .teachers { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .carousel-outer { position: relative; margin-top: 40px; }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 18px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding: 4px 2px 8px;
    }
    .carousel-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .teacher-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 210px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 26px 20px 22px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .teacher-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); border-color: transparent; }

    .teacher-avatar {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }

    .teacher-name { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .teacher-spec { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-600); line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 16px; }

    .follow-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--purple);
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.08);
      padding: 7px 15px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .follow-btn:hover { background: var(--purple); color: white; }

    .carousel-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); background: rgba(86,32,193,0.05); }

    .carousel-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .carousel-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .carousel-dot.active { width: 20px; background: var(--purple); }

    /* ============================================================
       TESTIMONIALS
       ============================================================ */
    .testimonials { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--off-white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 40px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 30px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.26s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .t-quote {
      font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
      font-size: 52px;
      line-height: 0.8;
      color: var(--green);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: block;
    }

    .t-text {
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.72;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .t-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }

    .t-avatar {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .t-name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--black); }

    .t-stars { display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-top: 3px; }
    .t-stars i { font-size: 12px; color: #F59E0B; }

    /* ============================================================
       TEAMS
       ============================================================ */
    .teams {
      padding: 88px 0;
      background: var(--purple);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .teams-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -150px; right: -200px;
      width: 700px; height: 700px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.07) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-glow-2 {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -200px; left: -100px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(85,218,155,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .teams-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 70px;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .teams-text h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.12;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .teams-text p {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.8;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .btn-teams-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      background: white;
      color: var(--purple);
      padding: 15px 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.22s;
      font-family: var(--font);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .btn-teams-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.22); }

    .teams-cards {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .teams-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .teams-card-val {
      font-size: 38px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .teams-card-lbl { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.62); font-weight: 500; }

    /* ============================================================
       FAQ
       ============================================================ */
    .faq { padding: 88px 0; background: white; }

    .faq-list { max-width: 760px; margin: 40px auto 0; }

    .faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200); }

    .faq-q {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 22px 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: color 0.18s;
      user-select: none;
      list-style: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      font-family: var(--font);
    }
    .faq-q:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .faq-q.open { color: var(--purple); }

    .faq-icon {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 17px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .faq-q.open .faq-icon {
      background: rgba(86,32,193,0.1);
      color: var(--purple);
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.32s ease;
    }

    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 22px;
      font-size: 15.5px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.78;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================================ */
    .footer { background: var(--dark); padding: 72px 0 36px; }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 60px;
      padding-bottom: 52px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }

    .footer-brand-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .footer-brand-logo-mark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.38);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .social-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      font-size: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .social-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: white; }

    .footer-nav-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.42);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .footer-col a { font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transition: color 0.18s; }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: white; }

    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-bottom-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .footer-copy { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); }

    .footer-legal { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); line-height: 1.65; }

    /* ============================================================
       MODAL
       ============================================================ */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(8,8,18,0.76);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.28s;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }

    .modal-box {
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 42px 40px 36px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 436px;
      position: relative;
      transform: scale(0.94) translateY(16px);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1);
    }
    .modal-overlay.open .modal-box { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }

    .modal-close-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px; right: 14px;
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }
    .modal-close-btn:hover { background: var(--gray-200); }

    .modal-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .modal-logo-mark {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      background: var(--purple);
      border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;

<script>
/* ----------------------------------------------------------------

const COURSES = [

  },

    id: 5,

    instructor: "Peggy Dean",
    students: "18,842",
    duration: "1h 18m",
    icon: "ri-robot-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6 0%, #06B6D4 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Marketing", "Productivity", "Freelance & Entrepreneurship", "Creative Writing"]
  },
  {
    id: 6,
    title: "How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide",
    instructor: "Brent Eviston",
    students: "26,243",
    duration: "5h 57m",
    icon: "ri-edit-2-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444 0%, #F97316 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Drawing & Painting", "Digital Illustration"]
  },
  {
    id: 7,
    title: "Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners",
    instructor: "Jordy Vandeput",
    students: "17,887",
    duration: "3h 44m",
    icon: "ri-film-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #1E3A8A 0%, #4F46E5 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Film & Video", "Animation"]
  },
  {
    id: 8,
    title: "iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone",
    instructor: "Sean Dalton",
    students: "13,423",
    duration: "1h 34m",
    icon: "ri-camera-line",
    gradient: "linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #0EA5E9 100%)",
    categories: ["Featured", "Photography"]
  }
];

const TABS = [
  "Featured", "Music", "Drawing & Painting", "Marketing", "Animation",
  "Social Media", "UI/UX Design", "Creative Writing", "Digital Illustration",
  "Film & Video", "Crafts", "Freelance & Entrepreneurship",
  "Graphic Design", "Photography", "Productivity"
];

const TEACHERS = [
  { name: "Lisa Bardot",      specialty: "Illustrator",                color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EC4899,#8B5CF6)" },
  { name: "Daniel Scott",     specialty: "Digital Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#5620C1,#8B4CF8)" },
  { name: "Derek Elliot",     specialty: "Animator & Product Designer",color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#3B82F6,#6366F1)" },
  { name: "Aaron Draplin",    specialty: "Graphic Designer",           color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F97316,#FBBF24)" },
  { name: "Zaneena Nabeel",   specialty: "Watercolor Artist",          color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#14B8A6,#22C55E)" },
  { name: "Emonee LaRussa",   specialty: "Motion Graphics Artist",     color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#EF4444,#EC4899)" },
  { name: "Brent Eviston",    specialty: "Master Artist",              color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#F59E0B,#EF4444)" },
  { name: "Jordy Vandeput",   specialty: "Filmmaker & YouTuber",       color: "linear-gradient(135deg,#1E3A8A,#4F46E5)" }
];

const FAQS = [
  {
    q: "What is CreativeHub?",
    a: "CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey."
  },
  {
    q: "What is included in my membership?",
    a: "As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more."
  },
  {
    q: "What can I learn?",
    a: "CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub."
  },
  {
    q: "What happens after my trial is over?",
    a: "After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round."
  },
  {
    q: "Can I teach on the platform?",
    a: "Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more."
  }
];

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HELPERS
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function initials(name) {
  return name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function formatStudents(s) {
  return s.replace(/,/g, ',');
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   COURSE TABS & GRID
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
let activeTab = "Featured";

function renderTabs() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('courseTabs');
  wrap.innerHTML = TABS.map(t =>
    `<button class="tab-btn${t === activeTab ? ' active' : ''}" data-tab="${t}">${t}</button>`
  ).join('');

  wrap.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activeTab = btn.dataset.tab;
      renderTabs();
      renderCourses();
      // scroll active tab into view
      btn.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
    });
  });
}

function renderCourses() {
  const grid = document.getElementById('courseGrid');
  const filtered = COURSES.filter(c => c.categories.includes(activeTab));

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    grid.innerHTML = `
      <div class="courses-empty">
        <i class="ri-search-line"></i>
        <p>More ${activeTab} classes coming soon — <a href="#" onclick="setTab('Featured');return false;" style="color:var(--purple);">browse Featured</a> in the meantime.</p>
      </div>`;
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => `
    <div class="course-card" onclick="openModal('email')">
      <div class="course-thumb">
        <div class="course-thumb-bg" style="background:${c.gradient}"></div>
        <i class="${c.icon} course-thumb-icon"></i>
        <div class="play-overlay">
          <div class="play-circle"><i class="ri-play-fill"></i></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="course-info">
        <div class="course-title">${c.title}</div>
        <div class="course-instructor">${c.instructor}</div>
        <div class="course-meta">
          <span><i class="ri-group-line"></i> ${c.students}</span>
          <span><i class="ri-time-line"></i> ${c.duration}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');
}

function setTab(tab) {
  activeTab = tab;
  renderTabs();
  renderCourses();
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TEACHER CAROUSEL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderTeachers() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const dotsEl = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  track.innerHTML = TEACHERS.map(t => `
    <div class="teacher-card">
      <div class="teacher-avatar" style="background:${t.color}">${initials(t.name)}</div>
      <div class="teacher-name">${t.name}</div>
      <div class="teacher-spec">${t.specialty}</div>
      <button class="follow-btn"><i class="ri-user-add-line"></i> Follow</button>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  // dots
  const count = TEACHERS.length;
  dotsEl.innerHTML = Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) =>
    `<span class="carousel-dot${i === 0 ? ' active' : ''}" data-i="${i}"></span>`
  ).join('');

  dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(dot => {
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToTeacher(parseInt(dot.dataset.i)));
  });

  document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: -cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
    const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
    track.scrollBy({ left: cardW * 2, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateDots);
}

function scrollToTeacher(i) {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const card = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card')[i];
  if (card) card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'start' });
}

function updateDots() {
  const track = document.getElementById('teacherCarousel');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.teacher-card');
  if (!cards.length) return;
  const cardW = cards[0].offsetWidth + 18;
  const idx = Math.round(track.scrollLeft / cardW);
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach((d, i) =>
    d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx)
  );
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   FAQ ACCORDION
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderFAQ() {
  const list = document.getElementById('faqList');
  list.innerHTML = FAQS.map((f, i) => `
    <div class="faq-item">
      <button class="faq-q" data-i="${i}" aria-expanded="false">
        ${f.q}
        <span class="faq-icon"><i class="ri-add-line"></i></span>
      </button>
      <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-answer-${i}">
        <div class="faq-answer-inner">${f.a}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  ).join('');

  list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const idx = parseInt(btn.dataset.i);
      const isOpen = btn.classList.contains('open');

      // close all
      list.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('open');
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${b.dataset.i}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = '0';
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        btn.classList.add('open');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        const ans = document.getElementById(`faq-answer-${idx}`);
        ans.style.maxHeight = ans.scrollHeight + 'px';
      }
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   MODAL
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
function openModal(mode) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  const emailInput = document.getElementById('emailInput');
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  if (mode === 'email') {
    setTimeout(() => emailInput.focus(), 320);
  }
}

function closeModal() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('signupModal');
  overlay.classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}

document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

document.getElementById('signupModal').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target === document.getElementById('signupModal')) closeModal();
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalGoogleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  alert('Google OAuth flow would initiate here. (Demo)');
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('modalEmailSubmit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const email = document.getElementById('emailInput').value.trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
    document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '#EF4444';
    document.getElementById('emailInput').focus();
    return;
  }
  alert(`Welcome to CreativeHub! A confirmation email has been sent to ${email}. (Demo)`);
  closeModal();
});

document.getElementById('emailInput').addEventListener('input', () => {
  document.getElementById('emailInput').style.borderColor = '';
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   HERO CATEGORY PILLS — deep-link to tab
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.hero-pill').forEach(pill => {
  pill.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cat = pill.dataset.cat;
    setTab(cat);
    const section = document.getElementById('courses');
    if (section) {
      setTimeout(() => section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 50);
    }
  });
});

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   INIT
   ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
renderTabs();
renderCourses();
renderTeachers();
renderFAQ();
</script>
</body>
</html>
